chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces a calculated provocation from Xiao Lang at Watercloud Manor. Can he avoid a political trap and keep his eyes on the Immortal Fortunes Assembly?
og_title: A Mad Dog Bares Its Fangs in the Grand Xia Capital
og_description: Ji Ning navigates a high-society banquet where a man known as a 'mad dog' tries to force him into a fight. Will the pragmatic Sword Immortal take the bait?
twitter_title: To Spar or Not to Spar? Ji Ning's Calculated Risk

lore_anchors.definition: The estate of the Xishui clan in the Grand Xia imperial capital, used for hosting banquets and entertainments including gladiatorial combat.
A cultivation path focused on physically tempering the body to gain enormous strength and regenerative abilities, rather than relying on elemental Ki.
The traditional cultivation path of absorbing and refining elemental Ki to control magic treasures and cast spells, requiring high levels of Dao comprehension.
A state of supreme harmony between a cultivator and the natural world, allowing for instinctual, flawless combat movements.
A grand tournament held by the Grand Xia Dynasty to identify and recruit the most talented young Wanxiang Adepts from across the realm.
A figure kept by a powerful noble for performing unsavory or aggressive tasks that the lord himself cannot do without losing face.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning refuse to spar with Xiao Lang?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning suspected it was a trap by the Shaoyin clan. Using a one-shot treasure in an unregulated spar could destroy his true body, whereas the Immortal Fortunes Assembly bans external treasures.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a 'mad dog' in this Xianxia context?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a useful political tool—a volatile, aggressive retainer who can do the dirty work, start fights, and threaten rivals in a way the noble lord himself cannot publicly do.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why were the alien gladiators fighting?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They were captured from a conquered small world and forced to fight for their freedom. Surviving nine battles makes them a soldier of the Xishui clan, a grim path to survival.
